info.title: XLR8 System Reporting API
info.description: Machine-facing experiment and analytics reporting under /system-api/v1/reporting/*. Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer <System Reporting API key> issued by XLR8. Access is limited to experiments in configured organization allowlists.
